Hon'ble Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.
Heard Sri Raghunath Prasad, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ravi Srivastava, learned A.G.A. for the State.

It has been contended by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is in jail since 3.6.2024 in Case Crime no. 190 of 2024 u/s 498A, 304-B I.P.C. & section 3/4 D.P. Act, P.S.
Baghauli, District Hardoi.
It has been submitted that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case as she has not committed any offence as alleged.

sentences.text: Attention has been drawn towards the impugned F.I.R. wherein the date of incident has been indicated as 2.5.2024 whereas the F.I.R. has been lodged on 2.6.2024.
No explanation of inordinate delay has been given in the F.I.R. General allegations have been levelled against all family members including the present applicant.
The present applicant is mother-in-law of the victim (since deceased).
No specific role has been attributed to her.
The relation of the present applicant with her daughter-in-law (since deceased) was cordial and she has never demanded any dowry from her or her family members.
The cause of death is hanging and as per the postmortem report there are two minor antemortem injuries except the ligature mark which might be caused due to hanging.
She does not know why the victim has committed suicide.
The F.I.R. has been lodged having ulterior motive and extraneous design in the mind of the complainant.
Charge-sheet has been filed in this case.
The applicant is a lady and she should be given the benefit of section 437 Cr.P.C.

The learned counsel for the applicant has given an undertaking on behalf of applicant that the applicant shall not misuse the liberty of bail and shall cooperate with the trial proceedings and shall abide by all terms and conditions of bail, if granted.
Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the aforesaid facts as argued by the learned counsel for the applicant.

Without entering into the merits of the case and considering the arguments of learned counsel for the parties, contents and allegations of the F.I.R., the fact the date of incident has been indicated as 2.5.2024 whereas the F.I.R. has been lodged on 2.6.2024.

No explanation of inordinate delay has been given in the F.I.R., that no specific role has been assigned to the present applicant, only general allegations have been levelled against the applicant, she has never demanded any dowry from the victim (since deceased) or her family members, no specific role has been assigned to the present applicant, the cause of death is hanging and as per the postmortem report there are two minor antemortem injuries except the ligature mark which might be caused due to hanging, charge-sheet has been filed, the applicant is a lady and she should be given the benefit of section 437 Cr.P.C. and the undertaking given on behalf of the applicant that she shall not misuse the liberty of bail and shall cooperate in the trial proceedings
, the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in this case.
Bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant Jaitunna @ Jakira, involved in aforesaid case crime be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions which are being imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant shall file an undertaking to the effect that she shall not seek any adjournment on the dates fixed for evidence when the witnesses are present in court.
In case of default of this condition, it shall be open for the trial court to treat it as abuse of liberty of bail and pass orders in accordance with law.
(ii) The applicant shall remain present before the trial court on each date fixed, either personally or through her counsel.

In case of his absence, without sufficient cause,

sentences.text: the trial court may proceed against him under Section 229-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iii) In case, the applicant misuses the liberty of bail during trial and in order to secure her presence proclamation under Section 82 Cr.P.C. is issued and the applicant fails to appear before the court on the date fixed in such proclamation,
then, the trial court shall initiate proceedings against her, in accordance with law,
under Section 174-A of the Indian Penal Code.

(iv) The applicant shall remain present, in person, before the trial court on the dates fixed for (i) opening of the case, (ii) framing of charge and (iii) recording of statement under Section 313 Cr.P.C.

If in the opinion of the trial court absence of the applicant is deliberate or without sufficient cause, then it shall be open for the trial court to treat such default as abuse of liberty of bail and proceed against her in accordance with law.

(v) The applicant shall not leave the country without permission of the Court concerned.
.
(Rajesh Singh Chauhan, J.) Order Date :- 11.11.2024
